name: slack-chat
description: Two-way Slack channel via Socket Mode: pipeline notifications + chat commands (/status, /pause, /approve…)

configSchema.label: Bot token (xoxb-…)
configSchema.help: OAuth & Permissions → Bot User OAuth Token. Scopes: chat:write, plus channels:history/groups:history for inbound. Or {"$env":"SLACK_BOT_TOKEN"}.

configSchema.label: App-level token (xapp-…)
configSchema.help: Basic Information → App-Level Tokens, scope connections:write (Socket Mode must be enabled). Or {"$env":"SLACK_APP_TOKEN"}.

configSchema.label: Notify channel IDs
configSchema.help: Comma-separated channel IDs (C…) that receive run notifications. /invite the bot to each channel first.

configSchema.label: Allowed channel IDs (commands)
configSchema.help: Comma-separated channel IDs allowed to send commands. EMPTY = nobody: anyone in an allowed channel can control worca-cc.

configSchema.label: Listen filter (optional)
configSchema.help: Optional comma-separated channel IDs to listen on; empty = every channel the bot can read (commands are still gated by Allowed channel IDs).
